instruction.text: Read the start of the story.

hint.text: The Iroquois people are a group of Native Americans coming from the north-east of North America.
hint.label: Iroquois

atoms.text: There are two worlds in existence: The Upper and Lower. The Lower World is filled with darkness and is home to monsters. The Upper World is home to mankind and the sky women.

instruction.text: Drag the descriptions to their fitting world.
Continue reading the story and answer the questions.

atoms.text: A woman in the Upper World becomes pregnant with twins, but unfortunately, her bed is too heavy, and she begins falling into the Lower World.

As the bed continues falling, the monsters of the Lower World work quickly to make a soft spot for her to land. A great turtle offers his shell to her. To make his shell softer, he covers himself with dirt and moss, and his shell begins to grow. The woman lands safely with her pregnant belly on the turtle, whose shell is still growing, now looking almost like a small island.

atoms.a: Where does the woman fall to?

instruction.text: Continue reading the story and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Even while in the womb, her twin boys begin to fight. The first of the twins wants to be born as quickly as possible and arrives earlier than his brother. He is called the bad mind, or Enigonhahetgea, and he is mean of spirit. The other twin is patient and is born on time. He is called the good mind, or Enigorio, and he is a gentle spirit. Both twins remain on the turtle’s shell.
